title: GAMA map provenance and claim boundaries
crs: EPSG:32651 (WGS 1984 UTM Zone 51N) for all GAMA shapefiles
how_to_verify: python scripts/rebuild_maps.py  # close GAMA first if includes/ is locked
In QGIS: load data/dpwh/corridor/corridor_lrs.shp and confirm ROAD_NAME contains Kennon Rd, Marcos Hi-way, Quirino H-Way (Baguio-Bauang), Baguio-Bontoc Rd
In GAMA: roads should be source=dpwh, source=geoportal_preview, or source=da_completed_fmr.
python scripts/build_corridor_dem.py  # display-only SRTM clip; optional
python scripts/build_atok_fmr_provisional.py  # before connect_road_network if FMR missing
credibility_rules: Official DPWH LRS is the primary road geometry loaded into GAMA.
Provisional Atok FMR (geoportal_preview) may be loaded; it is not the DA completed-FMR shapefile in data/da/.
Benguet DA completed FMR is loaded as source=da_completed_fmr. Do not bridge gaps.
Do not invent synthetic bridges or pink farm-access stubs beyond the provisional FMR file.
Farm clusters are municipal labels, not plot surveys.
Do not present the GAMA display as a digital twin of Benguet roads.
The corridor DEM is display-only. It does not set travel times or closures.

layers.may_claim: National linear referencing geometry as received; not the simulated world
layers.must_not_claim: Barangay FMR; surveyed farm points; that the full PH layer was loaded into GAMA

layers.authority: Derived from DPWH LRS by scripts/clip_dpwh_corridor.py
layers.may_claim: All DPWH LRS segments in Benguet + Baguio DEO (+ Kennon/Naguilian/Halsema stubs)
layers.must_not_claim: Complete local road inventory; official FMR

layers.authority: DPWH Benguet clip + optional provisional Atok FMR (geoportal_preview) + staged Benguet DA completed FMR
layers.may_claim: Routing on DPWH LRS in the Benguet clip; provisional Atok FMR when loaded; Benguet DA completed FMR segments that meet that clip
layers.must_not_claim: That provisional FMR is the official DA shapefile; a continuous farm-to-highway graph; full highland farm access

layers.authority: Geoportal DA FMR WMS preview (21 Oct 2026) + OSM Jose Mencio geometry
layers.may_claim: Atok farm-to-Halsema connector aligned with Geoportal preview corridor
layers.must_not_claim: Official DA FMR shapefile; surveyed centerline
layers.replace_when: An official centerline of this same Poblacion-Camp 30 corridor is identified. data/da completed-project FMRs are a different layer and do not replace this edge.

layers.authority: Researcher-placed municipal labels; distance to DPWH reported, not bridged
layers.may_claim: Seven municipal production labels (Buguias, Mankayan, Atok, Tublay, Kabayan, Bakun, La Trinidad)
layers.must_not_claim: Individual farm GPS; cadastral parcels; that every farm sits on a verified FMR

layers.authority: Named posts from frozen OSM dump (cited OSM way IDs), reprojected to UTM 51N
layers.may_claim: BAPTC as simulated post; LTVTP and Hangar as cited locations
layers.must_not_claim: LTVTP or Hangar as simulated trading floors in Phase 1

layers.authority: DA completed FMR project GIS, local drop 22 Oct 2026. Other CAR provinces under data/da/ are archive only.
layers.may_claim: Benguet completed project segments (182 polylines, about 95.6 km) are in the GAMA road graph as source=da_completed_fmr.
layers.must_not_claim: That these segments are the Geoportal Atok Poblacion-Camp 30 centerline, a continuous farm-to-highway graph, or plot GPS.
layers.status: Loaded through data/da/benguet_fmr_staged_utm.shp. Municipal maps in data/da/ are polygons, not farm points.

layers.authority: SRTM GL1 via AWS elevation-tiles-prod / Mapzen skadi; clipped by scripts/build_corridor_dem.py
layers.may_claim: Terrain backdrop under DPWH roads for map readability
layers.must_not_claim: Travel times, landslide probability, or BAU calibration from this DEM
